python.determinant2x2.def:
def determinant2x2(mat):
  # expects 2x2 matrix [[a,b],[c,d]]
  if len(mat) != 2 or any(len(r) != 2 for r in mat):
    raise ValueError('determinant2x2 requires a 2x2 matrix')
  a, b = mat[0][0], mat[0][1]
  c, d = mat[1][0], mat[1][1]
  return a * d - b * c

python.determinant_nxn.def:
def determinant_nxn(mat):
  n = len(mat)
  if n == 0: return 0.0
  if any(len(row) != n for row in mat):
    raise ValueError('determinant requires square matrix')
  a = [row[:] for row in mat]
  det = 1.0
  swaps = 0
  for i in range(n):
    pivot = i
    best = abs(a[i][i])
    for r in range(i+1, n):
      v = abs(a[r][i])
      if v > best:
        best = v; pivot = r
    if best == 0.0: return 0.0
    if pivot != i:
      a[i], a[pivot] = a[pivot], a[i]
      swaps ^= 1
    pii = a[i][i]
    det *= pii
    if pii == 0.0: return 0.0
    for r in range(i+1, n):
      factor = a[r][i] / pii
      for c in range(i, n):
        a[r][c] -= factor * a[i][c]
  return -det if (swaps & 1) else det
